and discern my cause from that of a nation not holy;

And why do I walk in sadness,
Emitte lucem tuam et veritatem tuam:
Send forth your light and your truth.
They have guided me and led me,
et adduxerunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernacula tua.
to your holy mountain and into your tabernacles.
Et introibo ad altare Dei, ad Deum qui lætificat juventutem meam. Confitebor tibi in cithara, Deus, Deus meus.
And I will enter, up to the altar of God, to God who enlivens my youthfulness. To you, O God, my God, I will confess upon a stringed instrument.
